note: Read-only snapshot of the Main App SAST language catalog, pinned so that a pack language id cannot silently become unreachable. Regenerate only after a new seam inventory; scripts/validate-app-language-ids.mjs fails when a pack id is neither in the catalog, aliased, nor declared as requiring a new App family.

requiresAppCatalog.sshd: sshd_config syntax; no App family and no extension (detected only by filename)
requiresAppCatalog.k8s: Kubernetes manifests; the App parses them as yaml with no k8s family
requiresAppCatalog.nginx: nginx.conf directives; no App family and no extension
requiresAppCatalog.tcl: Tcl scripts; absent from the App catalog
requiresAppCatalog.vba: VBA macros; the App has vbnet but not VBA
requiresAppCatalog.properties: Java .properties files; absent from the App catalog
requiresAppCatalog.basic: BASIC listings; absent from the App catalog
requiresAppCatalog.pascal: Pascal sources; absent from the App catalog
requiresAppCatalog.compose: docker-compose YAML; parsed as yaml by the App, no compose family
requiresAppCatalog.ini: INI/host config files; absent from the App catalog
requiresAppCatalog.postgres: postgresql.conf directives; the App sql family is SQL statements, not server config
requiresAppCatalog.awk: AWK scripts; absent from the App catalog
requiresAppCatalog.gitlab: GitLab CI YAML; the App has github-actions only
requiresAppCatalog.gradle: Gradle scripts; the App has groovy but no gradle family
requiresAppCatalog.mysql: my.cnf directives; the App sql family is SQL, not server config
requiresAppCatalog.blade: Laravel Blade templates; the App has html but no blade family
requiresAppCatalog.ejs: EJS templates; the App has html but no ejs family
requiresAppCatalog.handlebars: Handlebars templates; the App has html but no handlebars family
requiresAppCatalog.jsp: JSP templates; the App has html but no jsp family
requiresAppCatalog.pug: Pug templates; the App has html but no pug family
requiresAppCatalog.smarty: Smarty templates; the App has html but no smarty family
requiresAppCatalog.twig: Twig templates; the App has html but no twig family
requiresAppCatalog.cmd: Windows batch; the App has powershell and bash, not cmd
requiresAppCatalog.istio: Istio manifests; parsed as yaml with no istio family
requiresAppCatalog.asp: Classic ASP; absent from the App catalog
requiresAppCatalog.coldfusion: ColdFusion markup; absent from the App catalog
requiresAppCatalog.jinja: Jinja templates; the App has html but no jinja family
